statement: For an explicit radial compactification of the plane, the integer horizontal translation group is an actual closed discrete free proper interior operator group with a transitive boundary-fixed commuting translation subgroup. Simultaneous labelled evaluation on a specified invariant grid is continuous onto its actual image with the ordered-coordinate-plus-vague topology. An explicit concatenation of up-and-back row shears gives a continuous based loop in that image with an explicit based target null-homotopy, yet admitting no lift continuous in the original closed-disk map-and-inverse topology. A universal positive displacement bound applies to every proposed lift. The grid is the full lift of a quotient triangulation with the null-star property of C82.
depends_on: C81 actual source and operator hypotheses retained and verified directly; C82 null-star notion verified on the displayed grid; explicit radial coordinate and inverse, operator labels, continuous evaluation, shear inverses, configuration loop and forced displacement proof; only the topology definitions of arXiv:2602.07362v1 are cited
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), exact infinite-configuration topology and lifting obstruction in the remaining discrete-operator family-to-skeleton step.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. All actions and both topologies are specified. No theorem of the cited preprint is imported. Every target path value belongs to the actual evaluation image and preserves every original operator label; the obstruction applies to any possible lift, not merely to the displayed representatives.
computational_checks: code/part_b/c83_evaluation_path_certificate.py and adjacent JSON/stdout pass 143 exact symbolic and rational checks of the radial inverse, shear composition and inverse, operator commutation, literal row labels, full up-and-back interval endpoints and peaks, and strict displacement lower bound. The infinite continuity, explicit based target contraction obtained by multiplying each amplitude by 1-r, and nonlifting conclusions are proved in the text.
notes: This refutes path lifting, and hence the Serre and Hurewicz fibration properties, for the exact simultaneous evaluation map with the stated image topology. It does not assert failure of configuration-space asphericity or a nontrivial homotopy class in the actual centralizer. The separate Teh source-audit note records explicit counterexamples to the stated collar and tail-normalization lemmas and does not alter this proof. General C12 remains open. Frozen 248-claim inputs are unchanged.
